sources.entry: seedeep by duqaXxX - Reads the JSONL session logs Claude Code already writes and shows, live during a turn, what the session is doing: each model call and tool, the context window filling, every subagent on its own window and its own model, and the commits and files the session produced. Bun + TypeScript server serving a local browser GUI, with an optional Tauri menu-bar tray; single-file binaries

summary.one_liner: seedeep is a read-only live monitor that tails Claude Code's local JSONL session logs and shows each turn as it happens: API calls, tool calls, context window fill, subagents, and the commits and files a session produced.
summary.what_it_does: It tails the session log files Claude Code writes to disk and rebuilds the turn while it is still running, showing the context window filling, each API call with latency and token split, each tool call and its result, and subagents nested under the spawn that launched them. Subagents are shown on their own context windows and models. It runs seven deterministic waste checks as each turn closes, and it reports commits and tracker cards attributed to the session that made them. Data is pushed from a local Bun/TypeScript server to a browser GUI over Server-Sent Events. An optional Tauri menu-bar tray polls the same server and can send notifications for approval waits and failed API calls. It makes no proxy or network interception and writes nothing back to session files.
use_cases: monitor Claude Code sessions live while a turn runs
find where Claude Code token spend and cache re-reads come from
see which model each subagent runs on
get notified when a Claude Code session is waiting for approval or hit an API error
review past Claude Code sessions and search prompts and answers
check context window usage across sessions
how_to_run: Download a standalone binary for your platform from the latest release and run it
Optional: install the tray .dmg (macOS) or -setup.exe (Windows) from the same release
Inside Claude Code, run seedeep install-command to add the /seedeep command
notable: Read-only: tails existing Claude Code JSONL logs without proxying or changing the session
Per-turn waste scoring with seven deterministic checks, each citing Claude Code documentation
Subagents shown under their own model and context window, with the spawn tree rebuilt
Optional menu-bar tray with notifications for approval waits and failed API calls
Standalone single-file binaries that embed the runtime and browser GUI
caveats: Linux builds require glibc; Alpine and other musl-based distributions are not supported
Builds are unsigned, so macOS and Windows show first-launch warnings and macOS re-asks notification permission after updates
Under active development; the Linux x64 build has not been used by a person, only tested in CI
Desktop app Code tab does not show tool-approval waits as amber
